params.delta_definition: direct numpy sum over primes[N:2N] of p^(-sigma)*(cos(t log p) - i sin(t log p))
params.difference_convention: backward along ladder index j: G[j,d] = G[j,d-1] - G[j-1,d-1]; the log-N step is log(r), not log(2)
params.theta_definition: theta_rms = -(ln RMS_hi - ln RMS_lo)/(ln NM_hi - ln NM_lo); half-ladder RMS two-point ratio, NOT a least-squares fit
params.projection_definition: P(gamma) = |sum_j w_j * G[j,d] * N_j^theta_rms * exp(-i gamma log N_j)|, w = hann; inner product, not a fit

constants.aliasing_note: a dyadic ladder samples log N in steps of log 2, Nyquist pi/log2 = 4.5323601, far below gamma_1 = 14.134725; every zero-height oscillation aliases there. This script's ladder ratio r sets Nyquist = pi/log(r)
constants.band_rule: DETECT: global max of P within 0.5 of gamma_1..3 AND > 5x median(P); WEAK: a local peak within 0.5 of one of the three > 5x median(P) but global max elsewhere; NULL: neither
constants.o10_note: O10 is a deliberate gap in the series and is not filled by this script
constants.overlap_note: consecutive ladder points overlap because the block is still N -> 2N; this is oversampling of g(N), not a redefinition of it

summary.gate_b_note: read 480 O14 g_triangle[k][0] cells from O14_residual_depth_ext.json
